_comment: NUKE non-EVM negative-space worklists. In these ecosystems NO scanner sees the fund-theft classes; the barrage only covers the mechanical substrate (deps/panics/overflow/secrets/non-determinism). This curated list IS the deliverable. Source: verified survey wf_2151c1bb-dbc (2026-07). Each class: money = the theft path, tell = grep/where-to-look, vein = skill to PROPOSE (U-1).
